name: New World Order
overview: Scripture reveals that the concept of a New World Order involves the tumultuous assembly and vain imaginings of nations opposed to God’s sovereignty, as seen in Psalms 2:1. Prophetic visions in Daniel describe a divided kingdom symbolized by iron mixed with clay, illustrating the fragile and unstable unions of earthly powers (Daniel 2:43) and a fourth beast kingdom that will dominate and break down the earth (Daniel 7:23). Jesus’ teaching reminds believers that worldly gain is ultimately worthless if it costs one’s soul (Luke 9:25), and that true access to the Father comes only through Him (John 14:6), emphasizing the eternal perspective over any earthly order.
